name: Virginia Steel Specialties, LLC
old_description: Choosing Virginia Steel Specialties for your metal fabrication needs means partnering with a company that prioritizes quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Our skilled team provides many years of experience and knowledge in the industry and brings a high level of expertise to every project, ensuring precision and excellence in everything we do. Experience the difference of working with a company that values your success as much as you do.
about:
Virginia Steel Specialties, LLC was founded in 2011 in Ashland, Virginia, as a small family-owned business by David Martin. The company began with a 12,000-square-foot shop and has since grown into a recognized fabrication leader in the region.

The firm specializes in structural steel fabrication and welding for commercial construction and heavy equipment manufacturing. In 2017 it expanded to a 40,000-square-foot facility, enabling larger projects such as multi-story, multi-tenant commercial buildings, retrofits, and heavy equipment components. The shop employs a team of experienced fabricators and welders, though headcount is not publicly disclosed.

Virginia Steel serves a diverse customer base, with documented work in commercial building construction, retrofit projects, and the heavy equipment industry. The company emphasizes long-term relationships and a safe work environment as core to its operation.

The company's stated mission centers on delivering excellent steel fabrication, meeting customer needs, and cultivating lasting partnerships while maintaining a safe and healthy workplace. This focus on safety and customer collaboration is presented as a key differentiator.

name: Vishal Enterprises, Inc.
old_description: We are a leading fashion industry service provider with over three decades of experience. Since 1989, we have proudly partnered with the industry’s most reputable names. Our elite portfolio includes Ralph Lauren, Chico's, Neiman Marcus, and Bloomingdale's.
about:
Vishal Enterprises, Inc. is based in Northvale, New Jersey. Founded in 1989, the company is certified by the state as a Small Business Enterprise (SBE) and a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE). It began as a fashion industry service provider and has grown into a vertically integrated operation offering consulting, sourcing, and production management.

The firm provides a range of garment-related services including fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making and grading, sample making, custom hat manufacturing, alteration services, and full-package production management through a network of domestic and overseas factories. A strategic partnership with a Turkish garment manufacturer extends its capacity for cut-and-sew production, women's and men's apparel, and digital and screen printing. The company emphasizes scalable production from small batches to high-volume orders, with pattern development completed in days rather than weeks.

Vishal serves the fashion and apparel industries, working with established brands, independent designers, and emerging startups. Its client portfolio includes Ralph Lauren, Chico's, Neiman Marcus, and Bloomingdale's. The company also supplies sustainable fabrics and offers fashion consulting to guide clients from concept to sample.

The company highlights its certifications, over three decades of experience, and a vertically integrated model that combines consulting, sourcing, and production oversight. Appointment-only service ensures dedicated attention, while sustainable fabric sourcing reflects a commitment to minimizing environmental impact.

name: Vision Plastics Inc.
old_description: At Vision Plastics, we are more than an injection molding company. We are a plastic manufacturing partner who offers a full range of molding services.
about:
Vision Plastics Inc. is headquartered in Wilsonville, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The company operates as a full-service plastic injection molder with approximately 200 employees. Its capabilities span custom injection molding, clean-room molding, insert molding, and a range of secondary operations including heat staking, ultrasonic welding, automated mechanical and electronic assembly, and coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology. Vision Plastics also provides in-house engineering support such as design for manufacturing (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), mold flow analysis, and custom end-of-arm tooling and fixturing.

Vision Plastics serves original equipment manufacturers in healthcare, electronics, information technology, consumer products, and industrial equipment markets. The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer-focused approach and offers flexible manufacturing models to adapt to product changes over time.

The company differentiates itself through its people and culture, combining state-of-the-art machinery with lean manufacturing methods to reduce waste and improve efficiency. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification through TUV Rheinland and AS9100 certification, and aims for zero defects per million (DPM) through continuous improvement.

name: Visual Semiconductor Inc.
old_description: From phones and tablets to laptops and televisions, consumers are always looking for improvements that make their user experiences more impactful. VSI intends to develop and implement new solutions that offer enhanced viewing and user engagement through glasses-free and other advanced technologies.
about:
Visual Semiconductor Inc. is based in Bensalem, Pennsylvania. The company has been operating since at least 2022, as indicated by its copyright notice, and focuses on developing glasses-free 3D display technology under the GF3D™ brand.

The company designs application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) to power its proprietary 3D chips, coordinating with foundries such as TSMC for fabrication. It also collaborates with top panel manufacturers to integrate emerging display technologies including miniLED, microLED, and Dynamic AMOLED. Its development efforts target consumer devices such as phones, tablets, laptops, and televisions, as well as large-format screens for live events, advertising, and cinema. The company has demonstrated a 65-inch 8K GF3D™ prototype and offers private demos.

Visual Semiconductor serves the consumer electronics, television, and large-venue display markets, along with emerging sectors such as the metaverse, virtual reality, augmented reality, and holographic displays. Its customers include device makers, panel manufacturers, and strategic partners seeking immersive viewing solutions.

The company differentiates itself through its glasses-free 3D approach that eliminates the need for glasses, goggles, or eye-tracking, and through its proprietary ASIC architecture designed for high-volume, low-cost production with enhanced IP security. Access to next-generation panel technologies via its industry relationships is also cited as a competitive advantage.

about:
Vita Specialty Foods Inc., headquartered in Winchester, Virginia, traces its origins to 1898 when the company began supplying seafood and condiments to customers. The business has remained focused on those core categories for over a century, and it maintains an office in Chicago, Illinois, which serves as a primary contact point. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public sources.

The company produces a range of seafood items and condiments marketed under three brand names: Vita®, Elf®, and Grand Isle®. Its product line includes smoked salmon and other seafood selections, packaged for retail sale. The brand portfolio targets different consumer preferences, with Vita® as the flagship, Elf® for specialty items, and Grand Isle® for premium selections. Specific facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Vita’s products reach consumers through grocery chains, mass merchandisers, club stores, independent “mom and pop” shops, and online channels. The company serves the retail food sector broadly, with no specific industrial or food-service segments called out in its public materials.

Vita emphasizes a commitment to the highest quality standards and an ethical framework for the food industry, stating that its food ideas aim to spark imagination and drive sales for retail partners.

name: Vitek Solutions Inc
old_description: With over 25 years in business, we are a recognized leader in the telecommunication service fulfillment industry. You can count on us for a full array of telecom services.
about:
Founded in 2001, Vitek Solutions Inc is headquartered in Fenton, Missouri, and operates as a family-owned telecommunications service fulfillment contractor. The company began by providing installation services for local cable and internet providers and has grown to serve Missouri, Illinois, and Kansas.

Vitek's core services include construction, digital cable installation, high-speed internet deployment, VoIP setup, and multi-dwelling unit wiring. Technicians perform low-voltage cable installation, aerial coax splicing, and telecom construction using equipment such as bucket trucks, lashers, and directional drills. The firm operates three locations and functions as a primary subcontractor for Charter Spectrum in the St. Louis market, handling both residential and commercial projects.

The customer base centers on telecommunications providers, with Charter Spectrum cited as a key client. Vitek also lists medical and prescription MRF among its served industries, though the bulk of its work involves cable TV, internet, and phone infrastructure for residential and business subscribers.

Vitek differentiates itself through family ownership, a paid training program that develops technicians from entry level, and a workforce that includes many long-tenured veterans. The company states that continuous on-site training and employee retention are central to delivering consistent installation quality.

name: Vogue Furniture
old_description: This project was driven by the homeowner’s dream of creating a spacious, inviting, and comfortable ocean front beach house for their large and growing family. Knowing that our furniture and millwork would be present in every room of the estate, we chose a holistic perspective, carrying Vogue’s design philosophy and finishes throughout the entire home. Our initial inspiration was driven by the graduated louvered doors and shutters, designed by Architect Andrew Kirschner. Playing on that theme, we designed our furniture and millwork to have dimensional, horizontal elements resulting in a light, open-air facade. Don’t let the casual and beachy nature of the design fool you. Behind the shuttered facades and simple soft surfaces lie integrated smart appliances, automated retracting doors, custom floor to ceiling wine coolers, hidden entrance doors, expansive ribbed RGB LED lit ceiling, and motorized television ottoman and lifts. We produced a plethora of bleached, whitewashed, and wire brushed wood samples in a variety of wood species and finishes, emulating the colors, textures and feeling of the Atlantic ocean shore.
about:
Vogue Furniture operates from Royal Oak, Michigan, where Greg founded the company in 1977 after discovering woodworking in a middle‑school shop. The business remains family‑owned; Greg’s daughter Madison now serves as project manager and marketing director, continuing her parents’ legacy. Sue handles finance and human resources as an owner, and the leadership team includes veterans such as Steve W., who has been with the firm since 1992, and Jim, who started as a teenage apprentice under Greg and now oversees more than 25 employees as general shop foreman.

The company produces custom wood furniture and architectural millwork for high‑end residential projects. Its capabilities span design, engineering, AutoCAD drafting, fabrication, finishing — including bleached, whitewashed, and wire‑brushed treatments — and on‑site installation. The shop handles everything from single pieces to whole‑home millwork packages, often integrating smart‑home features such as automated doors, motorized lifts, and custom lighting.

Clients include homeowners, architects, interior designers, and builders focused on luxury residential construction. Vogue has collaborated with architects like Andrew Kirschner on oceanfront estates, delivering furniture and millwork for every room. The typical customer seeks a holistic, whole‑home solution that blends traditional craftsmanship with modern technology.

Greg started the business to explore the extraordinary opportunities within a blank space, maintaining a “no limits” attitude toward design, quality, and service. The firm differentiates itself by carrying a consistent design philosophy and finish palette throughout an entire property, combining in‑house design‑to‑installation control with the ability to embed advanced technology into custom woodwork.

name: Volta
old_description: Volta’s Low Voltage (LV) Products include UL1558 Metal Enclosed Switchgear, UL891 Low Voltage Switchboard, and UL845 Motor Control Centers (MCC). Our LV Switchgear is engineered by Volta using circuit breakers from various manufacturers. We can customize your preferred manufacturer of LV MCC to meet your requirements. Switchgear and MCC can be closed coupled with switchgear for an integrated LV system.
about:
Volta operates from Houston, Texas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Volta designs and manufactures low-voltage and medium-voltage electrical power distribution equipment. Its low-voltage lineup includes UL 1558 metal-enclosed switchgear, UL 891 switchboards, and UL 845 motor control centers (MCCs), engineered with circuit breakers from suppliers such as ABB, Eaton, GE, and Siemens. Medium-voltage offerings span 5 kV to 38 kV switchgear, MCCs, and variable-frequency drives, with arc-resistant and gas-insulated options. The company also produces Electrical Equipment Centers (EECs), integrating engineering, fabrication, wiring, and testing under one roof. Facilities encompass two 44,000-square-foot assembly buildings equipped with 20-ton and 40-ton overhead cranes, a dedicated skid fabrication shop for structural welding, and indoor sheet-metal and powder-coating lines that eliminate weather-related delays.

Volta serves the oil-and-gas, petrochemical, and energy sectors, with a customer roster that includes Occidental Oil & Gas, ExxonMobil, Phillips 66, Kinder Morgan, BP North America, and engineering firms such as Bechtel, Jacobs Engineering, and Burns & McDonnell.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model—engineering, manufacturing, integration, and quality control performed in the same facility—as a means to deliver custom designs with reduced lead times. Its IHB certification underscores a standardized, factory-built approach for Electrical Equipment Centers.

name: Vriens Truck Parts
old_description: For over 20 years we have been providing the Salt Lake Valley quality used OEM heavy truck parts. Ranging in manufactures from Kenworth, Peterbilt, Freightliner, CAT, and Cummins. Don't forget, we also have an experienced gear shop, ready to assist with your transmission and rear end needs.
about:
Vriens Truck Parts operates from a facility on Beck Street in Salt Lake City, Utah, where it has served the Salt Lake Valley for more than two decades. The company was founded to supply quality used original‑equipment heavy‑truck parts, though the exact founding year and the names of its founders are not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or minority status have not been stated.

The business stocks and sells used OEM components for major Class 8 brands including Kenworth, Peterbilt, Freightliner, Caterpillar, and Cummins. In addition to parts distribution, Vriens runs an in‑house gear shop that rebuilds and repairs transmissions and rear ends. The company emphasizes rapid fulfillment, offering overnight and ground shipping on most stocked items, but it does not publish facility square footage, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Customers range from independent owner‑operators and small fleets to repair shops that need replacement motors, bumpers, headlights, transmissions, or differential assemblies. The heavy‑duty trucking sector is the primary market, and the company positions itself as a cost‑conscious alternative in an industry it describes as prone to overcharging.

Vriens highlights its staff’s combined 40 years of heavy‑truck experience as a core differentiator, along with a commitment to competitive pricing and a stress‑free purchasing experience. The gear‑shop capability and the promise of fast shipping are presented as the key reasons customers choose the company over larger national distributors.
